def two_sum_recursive(nums, target, index=0, seen=None):
    # Initialize the hash map on the first call
    if seen is None:
        seen = {}
        
    # Base Case: If we've traversed the whole list without a match
    if index >= len(nums):
        return None 
        
    current_num = nums[index]
    complement = target - current_num
    
    # Check if the needed pair number has already been seen
    if complement in seen:
        return [seen[complement], index]
        
    # Record the current number and its index in our map
    seen[current_num] = index
    
    # Recursive Case: Move to the next index
    return two_sum_recursive(nums, target, index + 1, seen)

print(two_sum_recursive(nums, 9))
